title: 第22章 擂台赛
novel_title: 我有一个黑暗密武世界
content_zh:
训练室中。

    嘈杂的人声还在持续。

    片刻后。

    一道温和的声音从训练室前方传来。

    “都到了吧？安静。”

    众人纷纷收声，目光齐齐看向前方。

    一个中年男人从侧门走了进来。

    身材中等，穿一件深蓝色的运动外套，肩宽背厚，两鬓有些花白，看起来有些慈祥和蔼。

    除了身体结实一些，似乎和普通人没什么区别。

    段耀辉在陈峰旁边低声道了一句：

    “林东河，我们学院的副院长，第四境强者，这次省赛由他带队。”

    第四境……

    陈峰默默点头。

    林东河走到训练室正前方，扫了一圈底下的学生，也不废话，直接开口。

    “本次东湖省大一年级武道竞赛，暂定在一个半月后，为期三天，地点在东湖省城的东湖体育中心。”

    “全省三十二所武道院校参赛，咱们锦城大学是其中之一。”

    “今天叫你们来，就是把竞赛内容讲清楚，然后确定各自的参赛方向。”

    他伸出四根手指。

    “竞赛一共分为四个项目。”

    “第一，体测赛。测的是身体素质，包括爆发力、耐力、肌肉纤维强度、骨密度，四项综合打分，这个项目拼的是硬实力，体质高就是王道。”

    “第二，呼吸法与内气稳定性考核赛。主要考核内气修行的功底，呼吸法的运转效率、内气的凝聚度和输出稳定性，都在评分范围内。”

    “第三，武道理论知识竞赛。笔试加口试，考的是武道基础理论、经脉学、武道史。”

    “第四——”

    林东河竖起最后一根手指，语气加重了几分。

    “擂台赛。”

    这三个字一出，底下众人目光微凝，呼吸粗重了几分。

    林东河显然也预料到了这个反应，嘴角微微一动。

    “擂台赛是所有项目里含金量最高的，不论是省内高校、军方，还是各大企业，最看重的就是这个，其次才是呼吸法考核赛。”

    “原因很简单，体测再好，呼吸法再精，理论背得再熟，打不赢别人，就是花架子。”

    “所以，擂台赛的奖励也最丰厚。”

    他扫了众人一眼。

    “前五十，都有奖金，前十名，保底五万奖金，前三名，十万起步。”

    “校内奖励方面，擂台赛进前十的，直接授予三级助理研究生身份，享受一部分学校资源和实验室权限。”

    “而前五十的，都有奖金和学分奖励，优先考虑后续的各项国奖和补贴。”

    话说完。

    四十来号人交头接耳，训练室里嗡嗡声一片。

    陈峰没吭声，但心里已经打定主意。

    擂台赛，必须打。

    助理研究生的身份对他来说太重要了。

    灵药学所需的实验室权限、资源调配、白鱼APP的身份认证，还有后续的考研道路……全都与这个有关。

    “安静。”

    林东河抬手往下压了压。

    “四个项目，每人只能选一个，今天确定下来之后，后续的集训和备战就按各自的方向走。”

    “现在，各班跟自己的班导师确认参赛方向，十分钟后统一上报。”

    说完，林东河退到一旁，各班导师带着自己的学生凑到一起。

    梁越把陈峰四人招到训练室靠窗的位置。

    “说吧，你们四个，各自想报什么。”

    冯曦神色平静，第一个开口：“擂台赛。”

    柳毅也跟着点了下头：“擂台赛。”
content_en:
In the training room.

    The noisy voices continued.

    After a while.

    A gentle voice came from the front of the training room.

    "Are you all here? Be quiet."

    Everyone stopped talking and looked forward.

    A middle-aged man walked in from the side door.

    He is of medium height, wearing a dark blue sports coat, with broad shoulders and thick back, with some gray hair on his temples, and looks kind and kind.

    Except that his body is stronger, he seems to be no different from ordinary people.

    Duan Yaohui whispered next to Chen Feng:

    "Lin Donghe, the vice president of our college, a strong man in the fourth realm, he will lead the team for this provincial competition."

    The fourth realm...

    Chen Feng nodded silently.

    Lin Donghe walked to the front of the training room, scanned the students below, and spoke directly without talking nonsense.

    "This Donghu Provincial Freshman Martial Arts Competition is tentatively scheduled for three days in one and a half months, and will be held at the Donghu Sports Center in the provincial capital."

    "Thirty-two martial arts schools across the province are participating, and our Jincheng University is one of them."

    "I called you here today to explain clearly the content of the competition and then determine your respective participation directions."

    He held out four fingers.

    "The competition is divided into four events."

    "First, the physical test competition. It measures physical fitness, including explosive power, endurance, muscle fiber strength, and bone density. The four items are comprehensively scored. This event is about hard power, and high physical fitness is king."

    "Second, the breathing method and inner qi stability assessment competition. It mainly assesses the foundation of inner qi cultivation. The operating efficiency of the breathing method, the cohesion and output stability of the inner qi are all within the scoring range."

    "Third, the martial arts theory knowledge competition. Written test plus oral test, testing the basic theory of martial arts, meridians, and history of martial arts."

    "Fourth——"

    Lin Donghe raised his last finger and his tone became a little more serious.

    "The arena match."

    As soon as these three words came out, everyone's eyes narrowed slightly and their breathing became a little heavier.

    Lin Donghe obviously expected this reaction, and the corner of his mouth moved slightly.

    "The arena competition is the most valuable of all events. Whether it is provincial universities, the military, or major companies, this is the most important thing, followed by the breathing method assessment competition."

    "The reason is very simple. No matter how good the physical test is, no matter how refined the breathing method is, and no matter how familiar the theory is, if you can't beat others, you will just be a showman."

    "So, the rewards in the arena competition are also the most generous."

    He glanced at everyone.

    "The top fifty will all receive bonuses, the top ten will receive a guaranteed bonus of fifty thousand, and the top three will start with a starting bonus of one hundred thousand."

    "In terms of on-campus rewards, those who reach the top ten in the arena competition will be directly awarded the status of third-level assistant graduate students and enjoy part of the school resources and laboratory permissions."

    "The top 50 will be awarded bonuses and credits, with priority given to subsequent national awards and subsidies."

    Finished speaking.

    There were about forty people whispering to each other, and the training room was buzzing.

    Chen Feng didn't say anything, but he had already made up his mind.

    Arena competition must be played.

    His status as a graduate assistant was too important to him.

    The laboratory permissions, resource allocation, Baiyu APP identity authentication required for spiritual medicine, and the subsequent postgraduate entrance examination path... are all related to this.

    "Quiet."

    Lin Donghe raised his hand and pressed down.

    "Each of the four events can only choose one. After it is determined today, the subsequent training and preparations will go in their own directions."

    "Now, each class will confirm the direction of the competition with its class instructor and report it in ten minutes."

    After speaking, Lin Donghe stepped aside, and the instructors of each class gathered together with their students.

    Liang Yue recruited Chen Feng and four others to sit by the window in the training room.

    "Tell me, the four of you, what you each want to avenge."

    Feng Xi looked calm and was the first to speak: "The arena competition."

    Liu Yi also nodded: "The arena competition."
